correctness.rationale: Reconstructed GP(9,3) from the pinned RESULT.md and verify_gp93.py: graph has 18 vertices/27 edges, independent-simplex f-vector (18,126,435,774,675,252,36). Independently enumerated all 2316 nonempty faces and recreated deterministic 1148-pair vertex-toggle discrete Morse matching, globally acyclic by a full directed Hasse DAG test. Exactly 1 critical vertex, 4 critical 3-cells, 15 critical 4-cells. Reconstructed signed Morse boundary as the identical 4x15 matrix, with integer determinant +1 in columns 0,1,2,9; this cancels the 3-skeleton and leaves wedge of 11 S4, with no torsion. Flag complex minimal-support lemma follows inductively from deletion-link LES, and at exactly ten vertices forces complement of 1-skeleton to be a perfect matching. Independently exhaustively enumerated exactly 9 induced 5K2 ten-sets. Independent F2 rank of 5-boundaries is 216 and becomes 225 when adjoining their nine oriented join cycles, establishing rank9 in rational integral H4 (which is free). Independently recomputed signed Lefschetz character on all 18 D9 elements: rotations (11,-1,-1,2,-1,-1,2,-1,-1) and all reflections 1. Ordinary 9-point permutation character plus E3 matches, and one fixed carrier is orientation-positive. Finite exhaustive proof applies only to this 18-vertex graph, not a GP(n,k) family.
